fields.quoted_span: Give the tenant a 30-day and 60-day written notice (some evictions require 120-day notice or up to a 1-year extension).
fields.note: D041 supports the at-fault and no-fault cause lists, the Declaration of Intent to Evict, the 30/60-day notice, the 3-business-day filing rule, and the Right to Counsel notice from August 20, 2025. It does not support the FMR nonpayment threshold with the March 27, 2023 date, the 15-day payment and escrow rule, pro rata splitting, Mom and Pop relocation under LAMC 151.30, the relocation exceptions, or the Ellis Act and HUD sale details. Those come from other documents. The resident-manager condition (only if required by law) is also not in D041, which lists only 'A resident manager will move into the rental unit'.

fields.quoted_span:
must be filed with the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD) within
three (3) business days of service on the tenant
fields.note: D041 supports only the 3-business-day notice filing. The Chart A relocation amounts, the 15-day payment, the FMR nonpayment threshold and the $75 declaration fee do not appear in D041. They rest on D040 and D043.
The effective_date field is empty. D041 gives no original effective date for the RSO eviction provisions. It mentions only the Right to Counsel start date and other unrelated dates.
D041, last modified September 22, 2026, presents the eviction rules as current. It does not describe them as repealed, suspended, or pending.

fields.quoted_span:
Generally, the RSO applies to rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978, as well as replacement units under
LAMC Section 151.28
fields.note: The cutoff, the replacement units, the other covered unit types, and the luxury and temporary exemptions are all in D041. The 'supersedes_state_rule' flag is not in D041 and rests on D040 and inference.

D041 cites LAMC 151.09.C.9 for the filing rule and LAMC 151.28 for replacement units. It does not cite 151.09 generally for the eviction causes, nor 151.09.A.8, 151.09.G, 151.30, or RAC Regulations § 960.00.
